thread:
Alex R.: FYI opening incident: eu-west dedicated pools showing scheduler starvation -> increased p95/p99 and intermittent 502s for some reserved tenants. Posting status: https://status.redwood.inference/incident/1951234567
SRE-Bot: ALERT: scheduler::queue_wait_time > 1.2s (5m) | p99 latency 4.8s | 502 rate 2.3% | affected: dedicated-eu-west, reserved-pool-34
Jia L. (oncall): investigating. Initial read: job dispatcher appears stuck on a small set of long-lived calls, preventing fair scheduling. Possible regression from scheduler refactor rolled yesterday.
Eng Platform: confirming refactor 2026-03-20 included optimistic preemption change. Rolling a temporary preemption-disable to restore fairness.
Oncall Pager: taking action now: drain unhealthy worker nodes in pool-34, restart dispatcher process on each node, flip preemption flag -> false. Running: `./infra/drain-node --pool reserved-pool-34 --grace 30s`
Customer Success: pinged top impacted accounts (3) and opened tickets. Also noting spikes in customer-facing metrics and some automated alerts reached customers' monitoring.
Jia L.: after drain+restart (12:22UTC) 502s dropped to 0.4%, p95 down from 2.1s -> 0.9s. Still watching p99 which is at ~1.8s. Looks like some jobs are still stuck in dispatch backlog.
Eng Platform: started a targeted rollout to revert the refactor on the scheduler component for eu-west only. Canary at 10% now.
Product Ops: severity: SEV-2. Impact window estimate: 12:07
U12:23 UTC for affected reserved tenants. Will publish banner and update status page.
Alex R.: note for postmortem - need to include customer telemetry that triggered retries and the scheduling regression. Also add a checklist for rolling preemption changes with canary load tests.
Eng Platform: canary looks good at 10% for 6m. Proceeding to 50% then 100% if no regressions. Command: `kubectl -n platform set image deployment/scheduler scheduler:v2.3.1-rollback`
Jia L.: monitoring 20m after full rollout before closing. Queue_wait_time trending down. Leaving thread pinned runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/scheduler-starvation
Customer Success: will wait for stabilization before sending final customer note. Thanks team.
Alex R.: closing note: status -> recovering. Postmortem ticket: https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/1951234567-postmortem will be created.
